hook: One newsletter signup, and two weeks later the inbox was gone.

beats.text: They used their real address once, for a discount code. Then mail started arriving from companies they had never heard of.
Unsubscribing did nothing. The same senders just came back under slightly different names, and there was no way to tell who had sold it.
The fix is boring and it works. Give every signup its own address, so a leak stays in one place instead of spreading to everything.

title: One signup ruined this inbox in two weeks
description: A demo render produced entirely offline from bundled fixture data. No network, no GPU, no credentials.
